steps.title: Versatile
steps.body: Merlot's soft tannins make it flexible: roast chicken, pork, duck, mushroom dishes, lasagne and medium-rich beef. It handles some umami better than very tannic reds. Lighter styles can even go with salmon or tuna. Avoid very spicy food, which clashes with alcohol.

steps.title: Service and age
steps.body: Serve at 15 to 18 degrees. Simple Merlot is best within three years. Top Pomerol and Saint-Émilion age 20 to 40 years, gaining truffle, leather and earth. Merlot's softer tannins often make it approachable earlier than Cabernet-based wines of the same quality.

steps.prompt: Why is Merlot flexible with food?
steps.explanation: Soft tannins clash less with a wide range of dishes.

steps.body: An older Pomerol with a mushroom risotto or truffle pasta is a classic match. The earthy, truffle notes of mature Merlot echo the dish.

steps.prompt: Top Pomerol can age for 20 to ____ years.
steps.explanation: Great Pomerol develops truffle and earth over decades.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Merlot pairs widely, from chicken to mushrooms
Top Right Bank wines age for decades
